summary.standard_gate: 3/3 repeated Mihomo tunnel tests, consistent exit IP, median cloud latency <= 1000 ms, download >= 128 KiB/s, upload >= 32 KiB/s, risk feeds available and no known-bad match
summary.fast_gate: protocol verified, 3/3 stable rounds, cloud latency <= 1000 ms, download >= 512 KiB/s and upload >= 128 KiB/s; no reputation-list filtering
summary.test_scope: GitHub-hosted runner only; not a mainland-China measurement
summary.warning: Cloud-side validation cannot guarantee reachability or latency from mainland China. Free public nodes may stop working at any time.

cloud_tcp.meaning: TCP reachability only; not proxy handshake, tunnel, speed, reputation, or mainland reachability.

protocol.meaning: Mihomo tunnel and HTTP egress from cloud; not a mainland China test.

risk.warning: Not listed in threat feeds does not prove an IP is clean; this is not a reputation guarantee.

stability.meaning: Repeated Mihomo tunnel, consistent exit IP, latency, HTTPS download and upload from GitHub-hosted runner only; not a mainland China measurement.
